methods.label: Completing the square
methods.explanation:
Completing the square reveals a lower bound:
\[
f(x)=x^2-2x=(x-1)^2-1\ge -1.
\]
Equality holds at \(x=1\), which belongs to \([0,3]\). Therefore the minimum value is \(-1\).
methods.levelReason: This uses elementary quadratic-function reasoning and checks that the lower bound is attained within the specified interval.
